panels.description: Foreman-7 stands behind an amber node while Tomas is pinned beneath the collapsed frame. Keep the upper node clear.
Alex steps beyond the marked work boundary; his identity band flashes. Keep the upper display clear.
Alex wedges a salvaged bracket beneath the heavy frame while Tomas watches. Keep the upper frame clear.
The frame lifts and Tomas pulls free as Alex braces the bracket. Keep the upper machinery clear.
